title: Reduce complete idle-helper replay time by 70.96% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Reduce the complete PR6338 idle-helper replay's median wall time by **70.96%**, from 4.451050 s to 1.292454 s on CPython 3.12.15 / macOS arm64. This is a scoped evaluation-equivalence argument with exhaustive finite conformance and measured runtime evidence. No new mathematical bound or kappa is claimed.

```diff
 for each ordered projector pair L,R:
-  form (I+aL)(I+bR)-I separately for every scalar pair
+  form LR once, then evaluate aL+bR+abLR for every scalar pair
   check every 3-by-3 minor
```

All 14,400 ordered pairs, 230,400 scalar assignments and 3,686,400 minor checks remain. The opt-in adapter calls the original complete source `main`, replacing one evaluation function in a private authenticated namespace. It leaves predecessor files and the selected record unchanged.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit unpaidmoon / PR6338 for the verifier and scoped theorem; eumemic / PR288, Ali Romman / PR468, Nick Petalas and the retained span/register lineage. Distributive expansion, loop-invariant reuse and indexed determinants are standard techniques. The new contribution is this complete source-bound evaluation adapter and its measured replay improvement.

## Evidence

Five alternating complete subprocess runs per side, with the same interpreter and flags:

| Command | Median seconds | Range |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline | 4.451050 | 4.325744 to 4.648085 |
| Adapter | 1.292454 | 1.286811 to 1.498913 |

All ten exit successfully with identical stdout. The timed region includes process startup, source authentication and the whole source command. Other concurrent work was uncontrolled. Untimed profiling identifies matrix/minor construction as the bottleneck. Full matrix products decrease by exactly 216,000, while every scalar matrix and minor is still evaluated.

Normal and optimized conformance runs print:

```text
PASS_IDLE_HELPER_PAIR_REPLAY pairs=14400 assignments=230400 minors=3686400 determinant_vertices=512 rejection_controls=6 transcript=b64f711c3e8dad7f71702676fe48c1aa47b5ea8ac9b8b4ffb46f3136e99fdaa7
```

These compare complete stdout, all original guard counts and the ordered matrix transcript. They also prove the determinant-polynomial identity at its 512 Boolean vertices and reject rank-three, invalid-domain and changed-source controls. Explicit exceptions remain active with assertions disabled.

Local checks passed: both direct registered commands, metadata/pins and registered replay, committed bytes/source history, official nine-file export integrity, and read-only Git-free normal/optimized export replay. Each registered check took approximately 6.5 s locally; the registered wrapper took 16.4 s total. Export checks took 7.9 s and 7.4 s. No scientific check approaches the ten-minute CI bound.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/idle-helper-pair-replay/replay.py --mode fast

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/idle-helper-pair-replay/benchmark.py --output /tmp/idle-helper-timing.json

Set `TMPDIR` outside the checkout for disposable controls. Other installations can substitute their CPython 3.12 executable. Timing records are generated from actual results, bound to the adapter hash, and written outside the checkout.

## Limitations

The runtime percentage is one machine's measurement. Source changes fail closed and require renewed conformance. The adapter is bounded to the declared width-three/four, at-most-120-projector domain. SHA256 transcript comparison assumes collision resistance; the written distributive and index-order arguments establish evaluation equivalence. This does not audit the predecessor theorem, discharge any selected framework assumption or provide a physical supplier. Supplier cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review and proof-kernel acceptance were not run or claimed.

## Open next questions

Does the evaluation method help a distinct pinned minor-based fixture? First profile its complete command and derive its own transcript and failure contract. No second fixture or general dispatch API is supplied, and no continuation is reserved.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying this exact idle-helper verifier or its pair-rank replay was identified. The completion refresh inspected this account's open PRs created since the advance claim, including their bodies; none studies the same fixture. PR6338 is the merged predecessor. Earlier live-object searches, the complete cached open-PR snapshot and their coverage limits are recorded in the package README.
